Comment:
Reconcile a Cash Advance

Link the Expense Report to the same Spend Authorization that issued the cash advance.

Workday automatically applies eligible expenses to the outstanding cash advance balance. You do not enter the applied amount manually.

Review Cash Advance Applied in the Expense Report summary to confirm the amount Workday applied.

Important: A cash advance can only be reconciled against the Spend Authorization that issued it. Linking the Expense Report to a different Spend Authorization will leave the advance outstanding.

How the Cash Advance Settles
If eligible expenses exceed the cash advance, Workday applies the advance first and pays the remaining reimbursement to the employee.
If eligible expenses are less than the cash advance, the employee owes the remaining balance back to the university.
If that balance is still outstanding when a later Expense Report is processed, Workday will reduce the next reimbursement by the outstanding balance.

Do not record repayment on the Expense Report. Repayment is handled separately.
